00-resumed.changed: The archived seven-action checkpoint was resumed with unchanged weights, PPO settings and rewards. Goal-practice resets are the training intervention.
00-resumed.observed: The normal-start evaluation exactly reproduces the parent final results: mean progress 1,488.6 pixels. [Prior visual analysis](../2026-09-20-smb3-recovery-session-02/ANALYSIS.md).
00-resumed.fails: All five trials die; none completes the level.
00-resumed.uncertain: Five action samples on the same level do not establish generalization. Goal-practice training successes are not full-level wins. The curriculum may interfere with earlier skills, but these results alone do not establish the cause of regression.

01-stage.changed: 15 additional active minutes, using 75% goal-practice reset probability.
01-stage.observed: Mean normal-start progress falls to 1,154.8 pixels. Reviewed endings show seed 202 at the first plant pipe and seeds 303, 404 and 505 falling between wooden structures. [Reviewed frames](review/01-stage-overview.png).
01-stage.fails: All five trials die. Seed 101 dies around the early flying turtle; no full-level completion is demonstrated.
01-stage.uncertain: Five action samples on the same level do not establish generalization. Goal-practice training successes are not full-level wins. The curriculum may interfere with earlier skills, but these results alone do not establish the cause of regression.

02-stage.changed: 30 additional active minutes with the same first-hour reset mixture; no parameter changes.
02-stage.observed: Mean normal-start progress falls further to 619 pixels. Seeds 101 and 404 die around the first plant pipe; seed 202 falls into a gap. Seed 303 dies in the open enemy area and seed 505 near an early walking enemy. [Reviewed frames](review/02-stage-overview.png).
02-stage.fails: All five trials die. Four paired trials lose progress relative to the 15-minute checkpoint; seed 202 improves from 342 to 1,087 pixels. Overall performance regresses.
02-stage.uncertain: Five action samples on the same level do not establish generalization. Goal-practice training successes are not full-level wins. The curriculum may interfere with earlier skills, but these results alone do not establish the cause of regression.

03-stage.changed: 45 additional active minutes with the same first-hour curriculum.
03-stage.observed: Normal-start mean progress recovers to 939.4 pixels. Seed 101 falls into the gap after the open enemy area; seed 303 falls before the wooden steps. Seeds 404 and 505 die in the open enemy area. [Reviewed frames](review/03-stage-overview.png).
03-stage.fails: All five trials die. Seed 202 again dies around the first plant pipe. Progress remains below the resumed model.
03-stage.uncertain: Five action samples on the same level provide limited evidence. We cannot infer what Mario understands or attribute recovery to a specific mechanism. Practice clears are not full-level successes.

04-stage.changed: 60 additional active minutes; this checkpoint concludes the scheduled 75% practice phase.
04-stage.observed: Mean progress recovers to 1,597.8 pixels, slightly above the resumed mean of 1,488.6. Seed 505 reaches the tall-pipe area. [Reviewed frames](review/04-stage-overview.png).
04-stage.fails: All five trials still die. Seed 101 falls between wooden structures; seeds 202, 303 and 404 die around the flying turtles. Seed 505 falls in the tall-pipe area. Recovery in distance is not reliable level completion.
04-stage.uncertain: Five action samples on the same level provide limited evidence. We cannot infer what Mario understands or attribute recovery to a specific mechanism. Practice clears are not full-level successes.

emergency.changed: Training stopped automatically at 65.80 active minutes after invalid position telemetry. An emergency checkpoint was saved; no further training or frozen-model evaluation ran.
emergency.observed: Three normal-start training clears occurred in the final segment. Saved action replays reproduce all positions and frame counts and show COURSE CLEAR. These successes belong to the changing training policy, not an evaluation of this emergency checkpoint. [Failure and replay evidence](FAILURE.md).
emergency.fails: The final episode reports a position jump from x=1843 to x=1588 over two frames while still marked in-level. The safety check stopped the run. The emergency model and final 20-trial acceptance were not evaluated.
emergency.uncertain: The cause of the coordinate discontinuity remains unresolved. Three training clears do not establish reliable completion or performance of the emergency checkpoint.
